Term or whole life insurance paid at the end of the 1/m-th of a year of death

Source: R/frequency.R
insurance_mthly.Rd

Term or whole life insurance paid at the end of the 1/m-th of a year of death

Usage

insurance_mthly(q, i, m, n = NULL, method = "udd")

Arguments

q

Annual death probabilities from q_path().

i

Effective annual interest rate.

m

Periods a year.

n

Term in years (NULL for whole life).

method

"udd" (i / i(m) times the annual value) or "exact_udd" (sum over every period under UDD).

Value

The EPV of a benefit of 1.
